keep_features.evidence_span: Israel bombed Iran and Trump did jack shit

keep_features.evidence_span: A woman’s right to healthcare shouldn’t be up for debate

keep_features.feature_value: Recall prompt functioning like a rhetorical question

keep_features.rationale: Uses “Remember when … ?” structure to set up a comparative implication.

keep_features.evidence_span: But what if we could have our cake, and eat it
keep_features.rationale: Employs a hypothetical “what if” conditional framing.

keep_features.evidence_span: Even if you believe the theories about intelligence failures leading up to it.
